items.difficulty_reason: In diagram (equation-base-change), assuming g flat or more generally that f and g are Tor independent, the lemma asserts that the transformation a o Rg_* <- Rg'_* o a' is an isomorphism (statement lines 956-961). The proof uses Derived Categories of Schemes, Lemma labelled perfect-lemma-compare-base-change to see that the base change map Lg^* o Rf_* -> Rf'_* o L(g')^* is an isomorphism on D_QCoh(O_X) under these hypotheses, and concludes that the corresponding transformation between the adjoint functors is an isomorphism as well (proof lines 963-970). Transferring an isomorphism of left adjoints to the mate transformation of the right adjoints is the non-formal step, so the claim is H2.
